author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the release date trailer for PlantUp, a cozy time-management game developed by Malte Lehmann. Grow plants, process your harvest, and serve impatient customers before chaos takes over your shop. PlantUp blends cozy farming with fast-paced time management, clever upgrades, and a campaign full of challenges. PlantUp is launching October 8 on PC (Steam).
title: PlantUp - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Shunya is a 2D puzzle-platformer where you control a girl and a cat simultaneously. Draw magical cubes with the cat and harness the powers of Earth, Water, Fire, and Wind to solve puzzles and explore a mysterious pixel-art world. Check out the Shunya trailer to see what to expect ahead of the game's launch on PC.
title: Shunya - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: RuneCipher is a tactics RPG that combines turn-based strategy with active combat. Recruit unlikely allies, explore long-forgotten ruins, and uncover the secrets of an ancient magic to save your guild in this Strategy RPG inspired by genre classics. Check out the latest RuneCipher trailer to see gameplay and more. RuneCipher will be available on PC (via Steam and GOG).
title: RuneCipher - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Ruffed Up is a chaotic co-op physics game where you play as dogs dragging your unconscious dog walker back home. Team up with 2–4 players online or locally to keep your human safe, cross treacherous terrain, dodge hazards, and somehow get everyone home in one piece. It’s no walk in the park! 

Ruffed Up will be available on PC and Mac.
title: Ruffed Up - Official Demo Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Grab your MP3 player and your rollerblades in this choose-your-vibe game. Change the game with music while rollerblading through a small town. Talk to your neighbours, do shenanigans, and meet your first crush. Get a fresh look at RollerGirl in this latest trailer ahead of the game's launch on PC.
title: RollerGirl - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Do your day job remote controlling human beings from the comfort of your desk. Type out commands that they must follow, get them burned and bruised as you use them to investigate a deadly abandoned spaceship and decide how disposable a life really is. Check out the latest Remote Control trailer for another look at this upcoming sci-fi horror typing adventure game. 

Remote Control will be available on PC in 2027. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Remote Control - Official New Demo Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Enjoying an island paradise but craving adventure, retiree Erma is whisked away on a pie-baking-filled adventure to help new stranded friends get back home. Check out the latest Portabellows trailer to see gameplay, areas you'll explore, and learn about the release date! 

Portabellows will be available on PC (via Steam) on November 12, 2026.
title: Portabellows - Official Release Date Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet the characters of Poly Fighter in this latest trailer for the upcoming single-player roguelike fighting game. Learn new moves from every opponent you defeat to build your fighter’s unique style. Battle through tense retro-arcade duels with a choice of simple or motion inputs to master your moveset and claim your title! 

Poly Fighter will be available in Early Access on PC on October 13, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Poly Fighter - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Cosmic horror, through the eyes of a penguin. Watch the latest Penguin Colony trailer for this upcoming retro Lovecraftian walking simulator. In Penguin Colony, rival human factions have come to your home in the Antarctic, seeking an ancient and inconceivable being. Observe their descent into insanity in this faithful reimagining of H.P. Lovecraft’s At the Mountains of Madness, and other stories. 

Penguin Colony will be available on PC on October 16, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Penguin Colony - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Painwives is an atmospheric walking simulator where you play a pregnant woman sent on a holy pilgrimage by a fertility cult that worships pain. Painwives will be available on PC.
title: Painwives - Official Teaser Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Start your first day at work as an unqualified duck with a balloon and way too much confidence. Wander the Featherfall Islands, help quirky locals, and learn that “winging it” might actually be a real career strategy. Check out the latest No Wings Required trailer for the upcoming single-player open-world adventure game. No Wings Required will be available on PC.

No Wings Required is a pocket-sized, single-player open-world adventure packed with exploration, quirky animal characters, playful movement, and chaotic mini-games. You play as a flightless duck who exaggerates his qualifications to land a job as Featherfall’s new handyman, only to find himself solving increasingly bizarre problems with nothing but his trusty balloon and a bit of “can do” spirit.
title: No Wings Required - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
You are trapped in HOPE, a masked cult where pain is salvation. Every thought is tallied. Every smile is a lie. Conform for happiness, or face your guilt to escape. Take another look at Name of the Will in this latest trailer for the upcoming hand-drawn daylight psychological horror game, where cult life gamifies peer pressure and explores collective trauma. 

Name of the Will will be available on PC in early 2027.
title: Name of the Will - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a fresh look at gameplay and the world of Mira and the Legend of the Djinns in this latest trailer for the upcoming 2D pixel art-style Metroidvania, inspired by Moroccan culture and spiritual traditions. In Mira and the Legend of the Djinns, wield powerful ancient weapons and forge your way through unrelenting deserts, crumbling necropoli, floating islands and dangerous mountains as you try to uncover the secret of the last Djinn. Mira and the Legend of the Djinns will be available on PC.
title: Mira and the Legend of the Djinns - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Malhaar trailer for this upcoming musical slice-of-life RPG where you play as a musician and luthier who has just arrived in the mystical city that lives and breathes music. Befriend locals, solve puzzles and unravel the mysterious stories of the lingering musical spirits that only appear during the season of the fireflies. Malhaar will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: Malhaar - Official Demo Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the trailer for Deperson, an upcoming story-driven psychological thriller set in a dystopian future. Deperson will be available on PC and Mac.

In Deperson, you play as Aaron, a young man with no memory of who he is, exploring a strange world shaped by unreliable memories and surreal events. Your choices affect more than dialogue. They can change how characters react to you, alter parts of the world, open or close different paths, and eventually lead the story toward different endings. As Aaron recovers pieces of his past, the player has to decide what to trust, who to believe, and what kind of person he becomes along the way.
title: Deperson - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the demo launch trailer for Geometry Rift: Apocalypse, an arcade-action bullet hell roguelite developed by Dad & Son Games. Geometry Rift blends the luminous chaos of Geometry Wars with the addictive progression of Vampire Survivors. Thousands of geometric enemies fill the screen as players shoot, dodge, level up, and assemble increasingly destructive builds. It is pure arcade action: direct, spectacular, and driven by that irresistible urge for one more run. Geometry Rift: Apocalypse will be available in 2027 on PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Geometry Rift: Apocalypse - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the gameplay trailer for Arcade Warlord, a real-time business strategy game developed by eVdaimon Games. Set in the 1980s arcade boom, players build hit games, assemble a roster of specialist agents, move cabinets and cash across a physical city, and fight rival companies for the locations thatmatter. Arcade Warlord is launching on November 4, with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Arcade Warlord - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Wishlist Trailer for Constriction, a sinister PvP reimagining of the classic game Hangman game developed by Studio Onira. Solve the unknown words faster than your opponents to stay alive. Each correctly guessed letter tightens the noose of the person on the other end. The first to suffocate loses. Constriction is launching on PC (Steam) on October 9.
title: Constriction - Official Wishlist Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the gameplay trailer for Corridor 13, a psychological horror game developed by 
kanuddel. Wake up in an abandoned school corridor, memorize the reference route, and decide whether to move forward or turn back. Make twelve correct decisions to reach Corridor 13, but beware: some anomalies react, pursue, or try to kill you, and recognizing them does not guarantee escape. Corridor 13 launches on PC November 13, and a demo is available now on Steam.
title: Corridor 13 - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the latest Fortnitemares trailer announcing Five Nights at Freddy’s! The Fazbear Band has taken over Battle Royale. Face the animatronic animal bosses and survive the night… if you can. Fortnitemares begins October 1!
title: Fortnite - Official Five Nights At Freddy’s Joins Fortnitemares Trailer
